conventions.convention: Complex inner products are linear in their first variable; |u><v| acts on x as <x,v>u. The ordered two-qubit basis is (00,01,10,11), and C is the sum of the three Pauli tensor squares.

Density matrices are Hermitian positive semidefinite trace-one matrices. Separability means a finite convex combination of product one-qubit density matrices; entanglement means failure of this condition.
The dimer Hamiltonian is JC−h(σz⊗I+I⊗σz), with J,h in joules and β>0 in inverse joules. The exact separability threshold is restricted to h=0 and J>0.
The periodic Ising model counts exactly N indexed bonds for N≥2, including two bonds when N=2. The transported correlation result requires J≥0 and h=0.

The global model has sector multiplicities 1,1,4^N and energies 0,Nε,2Nε. Shell half-width satisfies 0≤Δ<Nε. Nonpositive β is only an algebraic finite-weight extension; canonical physical claims require β>0.

The Bose site assumes ACω and U>0, with occupation indices starting at n=0 and maximal weighted diagonal domains. The Fermi atom assumes U≥0. Both use β>0, and their Gibbs preparations are adopted model assumptions.

load_bearing.statement: Defines the explicit Pauli matrices, linear-first product inner product, rank-one operators, and C=σx⊗σx+σy⊗σy+σz⊗σz.
Every Hermitian trace-one 2×2 matrix uniquely equals (I+a·σ)/2 for a∈R³; it is positive semidefinite exactly when |a|≤1, and aj=tr(ρσj).
The normalized singlet has C-eigenvalue −3; the three displayed orthonormal triplets have eigenvalue 1, and these four vectors form an orthonormal basis.
For every separable two-qubit density matrix ρ, tr(ρC)≥−1.
The six-term equal mixture of ρn⊗ρ−n over the signed coordinate axes equals (I₄−C/3)/4 and is separable.
For each dimensionless x≥0, ρx=(e^(3x)Ps+e^(−x)Pt)/(e^(3x)+3e^(−x)) is separable exactly when x≤(log 3)/4, and entangled exactly when x>(log 3)/4.

Under ACω, the specified repulsive Bose site has a finite positive jointly locally real analytic grand partition sum, number-response identity, and the stated unique or adjacent-pair zero-temperature minimizers and entropy limits. The specified Fermi atom has covariance e^(−2β(ε−μ))(e^(−βU)−1)/ΞF².

The specified diagonal periodic quantum Ising model reproduces its classical finite-ring weights and stated limits. The global three-sector model has the displayed middle-sector bound, shell comparison, limiting normalized log partition, and positive-temperature mean-energy limits.

concerns.concern: Proof 2.1 treats p>0 and p=0, then says 'In both cases the criterion is p,q≥0 and pq≥|w|².' Since the Statement initially allows every a∈R³, p<0 is also possible. The omitted case is immediately excluded from positivity by testing the first coordinate vector; stating this would complete the case split.

Fact F2 attributes self-adjointness of real diagonal multipliers with general E(m) to lem-qsm-models-diagonal-occupation-trace, whose Statement restricts E(m) to additive free-mode energies Σj εj mj. The nonlinear Bose energy is outside that stated interface. Proof 1.1 supplies the required general diagonal-adjoint argument locally, so the conclusion is supported; F2 should distinguish that local extension from the supplier's actual Statement.
